RequisitionListForm.description: The RequisitionListForm container creates new requisition lists or edits existing ones with name and description fields.

RequisitionListGrid.description: The RequisitionListGrid container displays all buyer requisition lists in a paginated grid with create, edit, and delete actions.

RequisitionListHeader.description: The RequisitionListHeader container shows the list name, description, and action buttons for managing the list.

RequisitionListSelector.description: The RequisitionListSelector container provides a dropdown to select which requisition list to add products to from product pages.

RequisitionListView.description: The RequisitionListView container displays the full contents of a requisition list with item details, quantities, and add-to-cart functionality.
